chapter: Irish Channel and the Poesie shooting
title: Poesie's stand in the jail and his surrender and killing
summary: Adams relates how Poesie shot at police from his cell, then surrendered to the chief and was reportedly shot.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Was that right in the jailhouse? Right in the jailhouse.

They had the boy in the jailhouse already in the cell. Yeah. See, and that's where they struck that little buck beating the boy up. And so then they had a fire engine house around there, see, on that side. Then in the back of the jail, they had a, on this side, on McNordy's side, they had a fire engine house, had a shed, trapped shed, and they was getting on that shed and everything else, and Poesie seen them, you know, through the, through the bars, and he'd put it on, everyone would get up on top of that shed, he'd let them get almost up to the bars, almost, and he'd drive and you could see why they'd fall, and instead of falling back, they'd fall in front. Some fell back, you know, and he bumped them.
How many guns did he have?
Only that one gun he'd taken. He'd taken that one gun, then after he used that out, he killed three or four of them. Then he had the other guns right there by him, see.
I wondered how he had all that ammunition to keep it going.
He had that right there by him, see. That's what I was told.
Did he get out of jail then? No.

So anyway, so I was told now, they'd like to have a riot then again, on the kind of pushing them, see. So they're making everybody get back, he couldn't go see. Well, I didn't want to see, I just passed by there, and the time on that side when I seen all and hear about what it was all about, and I stood at the next second corner and heard about what it was, and I kept on going. I said, I didn't want to get no straight shots, even if somebody else was me. I never did run up to a crowd or get away from a crowd, always did. So anyway, and going, then I heard that after I got away and all, and all said, they got Persia to surrender. And after they got him to surrender to the chief, the chief made them all get back, and he went on up there and begged for it, and so the poor friend, look, I ain't got my weapon, I left my gun downstairs and all, now just surrender to me, and I'll be your friend, and I see that you get a fat saw. So Persia taking him out of his wood, and after Persia gave the gun up and gave it, and they put him in the automobile, in the patrol, in the car, wagon somewhere, and taking the way out somewhere on the highway somewhere, and they all shot him all up. Probably did. Killed the police. Never got no child, just killed him all up. Mm-hmm.
